sfx_review.label: chime
sfx_review.note: Tonal onset about 0.5 s before this burst; belongs to the end of the scheduling scroll (e013), not to this slide.

pattern.description: The settled Gmail screen begins to slide left with slight blur while a dark next layer peeks in at the right edge, the first frames of a horizontal push out of the scene on 'Or an AI sales...'.
pattern.why_premium: The exit starts with a gentle accelerating push timed to the next narration clause, handing off to the next demo without a hard cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.scene-gmail', {xPercent: -100, filter: 'blur(4px)', duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo('.scene-next', {xPercent: 100}, {xPercent: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.in'}, '<')
build_hint.remotion: Both scenes in an AbsoluteFill; progress = interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad)}); outgoing translateX = -progress*width with blur(progress*4px), incoming translateX = (1-progress)*width.

notes: Burst is only 9 frames (f792-f801) and ends almost immediately, so only the start of the move is visible; the full transition likely continues past the burst or into a shot boundary. Could also be the start of a whip or push transition; needs a human look at the following frames. Camera verdict is none (pan_x -0.0074), so it is reported as content moving, not a camera pan.
